question: In which year was the All India Football Federation (AIFF) formed?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1937**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **1937** is the year when the **All India Football Federation (AIFF) **was formed.
 
• The AIFF is the governing body for football in India and is responsible for organizing and overseeing all aspects of the game in the country.
 
• It is affiliated with the global football governing body, FIFA, and the **Asian Football Confederation (AFC)**.
 
• The AIFF organizes various national leagues and tournaments, including the Indian Super League (ISL) and the I-League.
 
• The federation also manages the Indian national football teams for both men and women.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The AIFF was one of the founding members of the Asian Football Confederation in **1954**.
 
• In **1974**, the **AIFF became affiliated with FIFA**, the international governing body for football.
 
• The headquarters of the AIFF is located in **Dwarka, New Delhi**.
 
• Over the years, the AIFF has worked towards the development and promotion of football in India, including grassroots initiatives and youth development programs.
 
• The AIFF has faced various challenges, including the need for improved infrastructure and better training facilities for players.
